svg.text: Design — signals become intents and standing claims; every row is a decision actor with one opening clause and one retracting clause
adapters append · curation moves · the word opens the intent · the type decides how an elaboration ends · the archive lands the line · standing claims move every planning digest
opened: session idle · gone: working again
flywheel exit · in the place · fixed kinds
every planning actor in scope runs
nothing of it on a branch
place kept · pane alive · rebased when idle
spawn intent in proposed · one row per intent
the ledger is never written on this side — a closed intent moves claims to standing, and that alone moves every planning digest in scope
